annotations.title: Find Public Pension Holdings by List

description: What public pension funds reported holding in companies on US government lists or in MORVS's registers, from What Your Pension Owns, a MORVS register built from the SEC's quarterly Form 13F data sets (Q3 2025 to Q2 2026 at launch) and five funds' own holdings reports, matched issuer by reviewed issuer to the Pentagon's Section 1260H list, Treasury's NS-CMIC list, DHS's UFLPA Entity List and two MORVS registers (the Detention Ledger's publicly traded operators, and the listed parents of vendors counted in Who Gets Your Data's government lane). Optional filters: fund (a reviewed fund's name, a two-letter state or a 10-digit SEC CIK), issuer (a company name, a ticker the register carries, or a 9-character CUSIP), list (a list ID the register carries, or its title), source (13f or report) and quarter (a quarter-end date the register carries, YYYY-MM-DD). With filters: for each list, the matched holdings by source, date and security kind, Form 13F rows and the funds' own report rows kept apart and debt apart from shares, each group's value split into holdings on the list at the holding date and holdings designated later. When the matches are one fund's: up to 25 of its positions, the two sources kept apart, latest holding date leading (holding date, issuer, shares or debt, the value as filed or printed, each list's names as printed with its designation or register date and the designation-after-holding flag, the register's claim sentence, and the filing or report rows behind it). When they span funds: each fund with its count of positions and the arguments that return its positions (for_positions). With no filters: the register's headlines with their basis, each list's latest-quarter Form 13F figures, and the counter-findings (how many funds' filings hold no reviewed match to each list). The two sources are never added together, and no total adds two lists, two dates, two reports, or shares and debt; a company on two lists appears under each. A holding is a position a fund reported on a stated date: it does not show why the fund held it, whether it followed an index, or what the fund holds today. A designation dated after a holding is flagged on that position (designation_postdates_holding) and its value is kept apart from holdings on the list at the holding date. The MORVS registers are not government designations. No state divestment law is applied. Answers are kept under about 25 KB. The answer carries as_of, retrieved, the file dates, the question, list, index, coverage and law notes, the claim rules, the licence and the source page on morvs.ai; an empty result carries the register's absence note (no reviewed match in that fund's filing or report for that date, which is not a statement about other dates, other accounts or holdings through outside funds). Pension funds are institutions; no person is named.

fund.description: Optional reviewed fund name (as printed or as filed), a two-letter state, or a 10-digit SEC CIK, for example CalPERS, NY or 0000810265.

issuer.description: Optional company name, a ticker the register carries, or a 9-character CUSIP with a valid check digit, for example Alibaba, GEO or 01609W102.

list.description: Optional list ID the register carries, or its title, for example dod_1260h or morvs_detention_operators.

quarter.description: Optional holding date (YYYY-MM-DD), a quarter-end the register carries, for example 2026-06-30.

source.description: Optional source: 13f (the SEC Form 13F filings) or report (the funds' own holdings reports); both, kept apart, when omitted.
